name: Firmus Technologies Project Southgate Port Augusta AI factory
notes: Firmus purchased land in Port Augusta in May 2026 with intent to build multibillion-dollar AI computing infrastructure; later reporting says sites near Tailem Bend and Port Augusta are part of Project Southgate. Per-site scale and construction timing were not disclosed.

name: Aurora Energy Precinct AI data centre campus
developer: 1414 Degrees with unnamed data centre operator
notes: Heads of agreement for up to 1GW AI data centre infrastructure at Aurora Energy Precinct near Port Augusta. Proposed staging begins with 17MW starter campus, then 200MW anchor campus after 275kV connection, with longer-term path to gigawatt scale.

name: DCI Adelaide 03 (ADL03)
notes: DCI announced acquisition of land in Technology Park, Mawson Lakes for secure cloud edge data centre ADL03; DCD reported the site had development approval, with specifications and timeline not disclosed.

name: YourDC / DigiCo Edinburgh Parks data centre
notes: Defence SA lists YourDC's flagship Edinburgh Parks facility as the only certified Tier 3 data centre in South Australia, with capacity for 800 racks; ElectraNet announced a point of presence at YourDC Edinburgh Parks.
